data.summary: The spell-to-duck sequence is readable and the mage ends by presenting one duck with a small smile. The right hand leaves the frame during the spell and stays outside it, failing the requested two-hand composition.

observations.text: One silver-haired mage retains the navy/gold coat, crescent and white shoulder armor. His right hand circles over the open left palm, creating gold rings and a central orb.
The right hand lowers out of the left edge around two seconds. The orb flashes into one yellow duck around 2.3 seconds, which settles on the same visible left palm. He looks downward toward it.

The duck remains one recognizable toy in the left palm, with a brief opening of its beak. The mage raises his gaze and gives a restrained smile toward camera. Face, left palm and duck remain visible, but the right hand does not return.
